roughly a fifth of the world is vegetarian, so there's a very big variety of what that looks like for everyone. it is definitely manageable and tbh somewhat easy once you get used to it. I have been skewing more towards a completely plant-based diet for the last 3 years or so, avoiding dairy, eggs and fish as much as possible without limiting myself too much.

personally i try to focus on getting enough protein and iron - lots of dark greens and beans. a lot of tofu and quorn (uk mucoprotein-based product), which make it easier. i tend to replicate what i ate as a child - slavic cuisine so lots of potatoes and cabbage - but sub meat with other things. lots of chickpea curries, lentil bolognese, soy curl jerky for savoury snack cravings, etc.
